category_title: Pre-engaged students with organizational and focus challenges
minimal_context: The student is reading texts out loud during a reading curriculum activity to practice decoding and comprehension.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please read this text out loud for me.

STUDENT: (Eager to learn, reads the text out loud at a very high speed) I finished it!

TUTOR: Okay. What did the text mean?

STUDENT: (Makes an inappropriate attempt to participate by shouting a random guess) It's about a car! Wait, no. Can I just read the next page?

TUTOR: Let's look at this page again. Tell me what happened in the story.

STUDENT: (Starts reading the text again at high speed) I can read it really fast, but I do not really understand the meanings.

options.A: Provide a ticket for each behavioral expectation met, exchangeable for a break or an item.
options.B: Balance grade-level benchmarks for decoding with the student's actual reading level.
options.C: Implement relatively tight timelines for completing the reading curriculum activities.
options.D: Incorporate the student's interest in dump trucks and tractors into the reading texts.
